card.name: Drugs used for a condition
card.fires_on: Linking words right after a drug class noun, such as 'drugs used', 'used for' or 'used to', where a disease or condition is about to be named.

modes.label: used after drugs
modes.description: The word 'used' or 'effective' right after 'drugs' or a drug class, before the condition.
modes.example: (i.e., certain drugs<< used>> for depression, psychiatric or emotional conditions,

modes.label: for/to/treat after used
modes.description: The word 'for', 'to' or 'treat' that follows 'used' and introduces the condition.

card.writes: It promotes words like disorders, diseases and treatments, so the next words name a disease or condition.
card.plain: It fires when the text says a drug is 'used for' something, just before the illness is named.
